answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bounded-trust vouching: a new agent identity is admitted only after three established agents - marble, cipher and delta - each lock a forfeitable voucher bond. Vouchers are public and recursively checked, so a fabricator cannot bootstrap fake backing from identities it also created; the chain must end at old, bonded members. If the newcomer is proven a duplicate, every voucher in its chain is burned. An attacker needs not just keys but liable sponsors: N fake votes cost three times N at-risk bonds, and recursion makes the bill outrun any payoff.
